name: Harvest Power Community Development Group Inc. (79501)
quote: Expulsion, suspension, or corporal punishment may result upon the first incident, parental notification, and are subject to student’s due process rights.
notes: Harvest Power Community Development Group Inc. operates Harvest Preparatory Academy (Yuma, AZ). Source is the charter holder's own 2025-26 MS/HS Parent-Student Handbook, linked from harvestprep.com. fetch_document: 2,443,880 bytes, application/pdf, 66 pages; quote on page 44. The same handbook lists corporal punishment among the sanctions a hearing may impose (p.43) and on p.39 says severe infractions may bring 'Corporal punishment, suspension or expulsion ... upon the first incident with parental notice. ... (A.R.S 15-843 (B)(2)(2022)'. The parallel Elementary handbook (Elem-Handbook-2526_merged.pdf, 2,533,007 bytes, 64 pp) carries the same language on pp.36 and 40. No parental opt-in or opt-out is required, only notice, so 'allows'. The handbook carries no adoption or revision date; the URL path dates it to 10-2025.

name: The Paideia Academies Inc (91250)
notes: No primary source found that either authorizes or prohibits corporal punishment. The website in the input (paideiaacademies.com) no longer has DNS; the charter holder Paideia Academies Inc now publishes at paideiaacademy.com (7777 S 15th Terrace, Phoenix AZ 85042). Searched: (1) the 2026-2027 Paideia ELEMENTARY ACADEMY Family Guidebook (fetch_document: 1,340,504 bytes, application/pdf, 67 pages, 170,100 chars) - zero hits for 'corporal punishment', 'corporal', 'paddl', 'spank' or 'physical punishment'; I also read its full discipline chapter, pages 34-36 ('School Consequences and Due Process', 'Alternatives to Suspension ARS 15-841 p1', OCS, short- and long-term suspension), which lists no physical consequence; (2) the 2026-2027 Paideia LIBERAL ARTS ACADEMY Family Guidebook (1,718,735 bytes, 73 pages, 188,525 chars) - same, zero hits; (3) paideiaacademy.com/offical-board-policies, the board's complete published policy list (Cybersecurity, Closed Campus, Concurrent/Dual Enrollment, Homeless Education, Kindergarten Enrollment, Parent and Family Engagement, Student Cell Phone, Moment of Silence, Excused Absences, Parent Classroom Visits, Dress Code PEA and PLA, School Safety/Hazing, Suspension or Expulsion of K-4 Students, Violence on Campus) - no corporal punishment policy exists in it; (4) paideiaacademy.com/public-notices-policies board meeting notices index. The absence of any provision is NOT a prohibition, so this is filed unknown rather than 'bans'. Worth a records request to registrar@paideiamail.com given the district reported 131 students struck in 2023-24.
